scope: Focused staged Git blob reads; not application startup or physical-device release validation

workload.selection: first 60 sorted shared/*.js paths in the proposed index

after.method: one git cat-file --batch process with captured object IDs and blob reuse

limitations: Single focused sample per implementation; no claim about median, p95, total commit latency or app/provider performance. Git inventory and process creation outside the read loop were excluded for both implementations.
